verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a coding agent that stores sessions, conversation history and settings, so the axis applies. The pack documents no export feature for that data in open formats. CLAUDE.md being a markdown file and code living in the user's own git repo are adjacent facts, not an export capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
